capitals.note: 'Its capital and largest city is Antananarivo'; founded as the capital of the Imerina Kingdom 'around 1610 or 1625'. No change of capital is recorded.

ledger.note: 1960: Madagascar becomes fully independent from France. 'The Malagasy Republic was proclaimed on 14 October 1958, as an autonomous state within the French Community'; 'full independence on 26 June 1960'. The 1958-1960 autonomy is not drawn as a separate state.

1975: the First Republic gives way to the Marxist-Leninist Second Republic under Didier Ratsiraka. The infobox lists 'Socialist state: 30 December 1975 - 12 January 1992'; the page's text says the Second Republic 'ran under his tenure from 1975 to 1993', and the new official name is not spelled out on the page. Same state and land (rule 2).

certainty.note: An island: the coastline is the border. The offshore Scattered Islands claimed from France are not covered by the page and are not in the shape.

sources.title: Madagascar
sources.note: Malagasy Republic proclaimed 14 October 1958, independence 26 June 1960, republics of 1960-72, 1975-92 and 1992-2010, capital Antananarivo, area 592,796 km2.

notes: Cliopatria: two shapes (1960-2023, 2024) of 616,267 km2, the whole island, identical; ratio 1.04 to the infobox. One page opened (budget 1-2 pages). Start year follows Cliopatria and sovereignty (26 June 1960); the autonomous Malagasy Republic of 14 October 1958 within the French Community is a note, not a keyframe. Whether Cliopatria's French Fifth Republic row draws the island in 1958-1959 is unchecked (no neighbours listed). Not on the page: the Scattered Islands dispute with France (Glorioso, Juan de Nova, Europa, Bassas da India), the Mayotte and Comoros matter (the page only lists the Comoros and Mayotte as neighbours), and the 1947 Malagasy Uprising (before the state). No war or border change after 1960 appears, so wars is empty. Rulers: the page dates Tsiranana 1960-1972, Ramanantsoa 1972-1975, Ratsiraka 1975-1993 and 1996-2001, Zafy 1993-1996, Ratsirahonana 1996 (three months), Rajoelina from March 2009 and Randrianirina from 17 October 2025, but gives no dates for Ravalomanana or for Rajaonarimampianina (winner of the 2013 election), so no ruler strip. Gazetteer: 'Madagascar' as a country resolves; no new names needed.
